title: Correct Matched Study Scoring, Zero-Spin Domain, Diagnostics and Matrix Provenance
acceptance:
Astra independent phase-two review identified four implementation gaps before final simulation.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Custom approach green radius must reach course scoring; regression uses a nondefault radius.
2. Positive-speed airborne zero-spin launches must remain valid; undefined spin axis is explicit and frictionless/ballistic tests pass.
3. Export unit-labelled joint delivery/outcome covariance, pair counts and null correlations for constant/undefined variables, including launch azimuth and spin axis.
4. Matrix execution must reject source changes between cells as well as during a cell and bind every cell receipt to the frozen plan.

Use failing regressions first; retain independent review and exact validation evidence. Do not close until merged implementation satisfies all criteria.

## Additional Presentation Acceptance

Conditional strokes-gained heatmap annotations must use the common paired scoring population, not the larger per-pattern supported count. Add a regression with unequal per-pattern supported counts and smaller common intersection; label physical scored sample size accurately.

## Additional Archive Integrity Acceptance

Reject a source inventory or earlier-copied file change before archive publication. Verification must reject symbolic-link/special-file ZIP members even when their payload and archive hashes match a self-consistent manifest. Preserve three red-to-green regressions; immutable existing regular-file pilot bundles retain their original hashes.

## Portable Archive Verification

Reject Windows drive-qualified ZIP member names, including C:/escape and C:escape, on all platforms. Two self-consistent archive regressions failed before the PureWindowsPath drive check and pass after it; archive suite now has 12 passing tests.

## Final Publication Acceptance

Resolve branch-specific Diff Mypy errors (density float64 edge types and independent audit-script annotations) without changing active frozen execution sources. Preserve historical receipts and document post-run type-only source transitions. Provide direct SD1/SD2 and curve1/curve2 density comparisons with common axes and density scales, so independently autoscaled figures cannot imply equal spread. Preserve all unavailable matched cases in comparison ledgers.

## GUI and Publication Review Findings

Regression fixes required: the matched tab must fit a 1000 x 760 launcher window with controls reachable by scrolling and Run/Cancel visible; correlation headers must remain readable and identify exported input fields. Final figure metadata must distinguish static club loft from delivered loft, enforce exact final study stage/count/shot protocol, and recheck source bytes after reading to prevent attribution to stale manifests. Each fix requires a failing regression first and passing focused validation; frozen simulation sources remain unchanged during production.

## Report Population Accounting

Keep planned versus attempted shot counts separate for unavailable cells (planned 10000, attempted 0); label direction-count summaries explicitly as completed-cell analyses and disclose excluded unavailable plan cells. Regression fixes are committed in 2de9960b77 with seven report tests, Ruff and mypy passing. Final-data audit remains pending.

## Publication Layout and Metadata

Actual matched configs have no delivery_mode field; figure metadata must explicitly identify matched raw landings and show the saved per-pattern nominal face, path and speed. Corrected in fc5435a951 and independently visually checked in ae66a99f28. Preserve unavailable-under-model/search-bounds wording and use simulated rather than empirical for generated endpoint quadrants. PDF table pagination must not strand a single body row after a page break; fix the shared renderer rather than narrowing only the pilot preview. Provide links to full-resolution graphics beside embedded report figures. The final report still requires actual final-data rendering and visual acceptance.

## Supplemental Comparison Review
Root review of a78bd9d002 identified these acceptance gaps before final reporting:

- Normalize only known historical default bounds when comparing old saved configurations with new supplemental configurations. Preserve the original configuration bytes and source hashes. Reject undeclared physical/noise changes.
- Support the requested 0/5/10-degree lean comparisons, including qualified supplemental-to-original sources; a hard-coded 0/5 restriction omits required comparisons.
- Compute curve-strength as well as variability effect modification using the rowwise difference of curve-minus-straight SG benefits on the same six-population supported-index intersection. Do not subtract separately conditioned summaries.
- Make comparison direction explicit: a reversed SD input must not be labeled as 2-degree minus 1-degree. Assemble every scoring vector in the same sorted shot-index order, independent of CSV ordering.
- Revalidate source bytes after analysis, and use a shared public per-shot scoring helper. The temporary reporting helper duplicates the canonical course geometry and lie-selection logic and must be consolidated, with source-equivalence tests, after respecting the running model's source freeze.

Luna is implementing regression tests and pairing fixes. Sol is preparing the public scoring helper in the isolated bounds worktree, and Astra will review the resulting source transition and calculations. The existing simulation sources remain unchanged while the original workers run. No final result acceptance is claimed.


## Final-Size Visual and End-to-End Comparison Review
Review of an actual completed driver cell with 10,000 shots per pattern found two presentation problems: dense colored point overlays obscure the common density scale, and overhead trajectory panels magnify lateral displacement without stating the display scale. Retain every supported point in density, HDR and marginals; if dots are subsampled for legibility, disclose deterministic shown/total counts. Improve trajectory contrast and explicitly state the computed lateral display magnification (or use equal physical scales). Qualify the final rendered output independently; do not change original frozen plots while production workers run.

Astra review of 5df7335879 additionally found that the full explicit-source driver comparison rejects the permitted speed-bound change: list differences are named match_speed_factors[1], while the exception recognizes the parent key. Add a failing full public-API comparison regression, permit only the predeclared driver protocol's exact change, and continue rejecting undeclared bounds/physics changes. A passing helper-predicate test alone is insufficient.

GUI exact-round-trip fixes are committed in the isolated branch at b102ad0cf9: loading a saved target must preserve its numeric value and an implicit correlation matrix must preserve its serialization. Unsupported precision must be rejected before partial application. Twenty-two UI tests pass and three 1000-by-760 offscreen captures have been visually reviewed. Final numerical/source-transition acceptance remains pending.


## Current Review Progress
The explicit-source comparison API at eac423b7337 passed Astra's stable independent 30-test review (58d510c904; logs preserved in f8b18939ce). Prior driver speed-vector, protected-source/runtime, post-analysis evidence and scorer-provenance findings are resolved in that reviewed API. Full report-pipeline and final-data acceptance remain pending.

Actual saved-data component checks also pass for driver curve-1 combined-2 SD1-to-SD2 comparisons at lean 0 and 5 degrees. Common supported n is respectively 10000 and 9939; at lean 5 the separately supported populations are 9974 and 9940, so the common intersection matters. Independently assembled rowwise difference-of-differences means agree exactly. This is not full-matrix acceptance or empirical validation.

Final-size visual review additionally requires shared marginal probability-density limits across pattern panels (the earlier top marginals autoscaled independently). Add an axis-limit regression and keep the common joint-density color scale. Dedicated concise social density and overhead exports must be distinct from the detailed academic assets, with protocol, support, sampling and display-scale disclosures. These presentation corrections are being finalized in the isolated worktree while original simulation sources stay frozen.

Both existing pilot archives were restored into a fresh directory: all 2604 files match hashes, and restored complete reports equal the local originals. Validation evidence is committed in 12d524602d; final datasets still await completion, audit and packaging.


## Supplemental Pipeline Acceptance Findings
Astra's preliminary review is committed in 7713d4d421; the new pipeline is not accepted yet. Resolve with failing regressions first:

- Validate the exact original factorial inventory, seed, configurations and fixed-target mode, not merely 324/72 cell counts and 10000 shots. Share a strict contract with the original final-report entrypoint.
- Export an additive inventory of every original cell/status/reason (all 396), preserving original unavailable rows alongside separately labeled supplemental cases.
- Per-cell density must plot each pattern's individual supported population, matching its count/summary; the scoring helper's three-pattern intersection cannot be relabeled as individual support. Paired condition density uses the six-population intersection and must disclose common n / attempted N.
- Distinct density and overhead artifact keys must survive ledger assembly: updating two dictionaries keyed only png/pdf/svg overwrites density entries. Test both assets and their hashes, including social exports.
- Comparison captions must include club, noise profile, actual compared SD/curve/lean settings and source protocols. Saved overhead paths are illustrative samples and must not be labeled as the six-population paired index set; show path counts and physical axis scale/magnification.
- Publish a completed final receipt only after every source/evidence stability check succeeds. A late failure must not leave a misleading completed artifact.
- Consolidate duplicate nominal-target validation and population-loading logic through shared report helpers; retain strict tolerances, tests and file-size budgets. Separate condition densities must share bins/color limits without misleading filled-layer compositing.

Luna is implementing these fixes; Astra will re-review stable source and rendered outputs. Original simulations and immutable acceptance remain unchanged.


## Final Report Coverage Findings
Sol's read-only coverage audit identified six remaining publication requirements. Implement with test-first evidence and independent review before final publication:

- Explain actual noisy carry bias and longitudinal/lateral dispersion by club and lean. Matching zero-error landings is not an equal-carry-distribution experiment. Do not causally attribute SG changes to distance from marginal summaries alone.
- Report representative delivered face/loft statistics or covariance and long-left/short-right quadrants beyond lean zero, using saved data and explicitly geometric model assumptions. Answer the shaft-lean question directly.
- Report qualified common-six-population SD1-to-SD2 and curve-strength effect modification, with paired intervals and conditional denominators. Separate-condition SG tables alone do not answer whether relative curve benefit changes.
- State driver tee and iron/wedge approach baseline geometry with absolute mean SG/support as well as paired differences and course sensitivity; do not mix individual and common-population estimates.
- Label unavailable unattempted rows Not Attempted, not supported zero. Show supported fractions and their uncertainty for selected results where defined.
- Provide actual all-club academic overhead/density graphics and Facebook assets/index links, resolving wedge availability and supplemental protocol labels from the artifact inventory. Do not hardcode missing assets.

Sol is implementing a focused interpretation module and tests, coordinating final builder integration with Luna. These are report-only changes; original execution and accepted supplemental source-transition evidence remain immutable. Final empirical validation remains deferred, not satisfied by these additions.
